metadata.reconciliation: Adheres to BulletTrain WS8 / L-CAID-10 zero-mock principle: tests against live running Woodpecker server instance, real PostgreSQL 16 database with Google Tink AEAD envelope encryption, real Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B endpoint, and real gRPC streaming transport.

test_cases.scenario: Trigger pipeline execution on live server; step encounters OOM Exit 137; L1 self-healer escalates memory 1.5x in PostgreSQL metadata and completes with status: SUCCESS
expected_outcomes: Live server intercepts Exit 137 OOM
PostgreSQL step metadata updated to 3GB (1.5x of 2GB)
Rescheduled pipeline run completes successfully
test_cases.preconditions: Woodpecker server running on :8000 with PostgreSQL 16 backend
test_cases.notes: Verified against live Woodpecker REST API and PostgreSQL 16

test_cases.scenario: PR targeting protected branch creates gated pipeline; non-CSO token receives HTTP 403 ACCOUNTABLE_HUMAN_REQUIRED; authorized CSO unblocks pipeline
expected_outcomes: Live server sets pipeline status to GATED
Unauthorized approval attempt refused with 403
Certified CSO approval unblocks pipeline to RUNNING
test_cases.preconditions: Woodpecker server running with DCB0129 branch protection enabled
test_cases.notes: Validates statutory accountable human gate over live HTTP API

test_cases.scenario: Pipeline emitting live NHS Modulus 11 and BulletTrain Client Registry IDs (CR-94812, MPI-3091); real streaming sentry sanitizes logs before PostgreSQL storage
expected_outcomes: Streaming log interceptor redacts patient identifiers in real-time
PostgreSQL raw log rows contain only sanitized tokens [REDACTED_PATIENT_ID]
Zero raw patient IDs persisted in database
test_cases.preconditions: Live server running with Zero-PHI sentry enabled
test_cases.notes: Verified against real streaming log transport and DB persistence

test_cases.scenario: Secrets created via POST /api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/secrets; raw PostgreSQL query confirms ciphertext envelope; API retrieval returns decrypted plaintext
expected_outcomes: Secret persisted to PostgreSQL as Tink AEAD ciphertext envelope
Direct SQL query confirms plaintext is never stored in DB
Server decrypts secret in memory only during authorized step execution

test_cases.scenario: Step failure triggers diagnostic dispatch to local endpoint (http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1/chat/completions); returns structured RCA JSON with proposed diff
expected_outcomes: Diagnostic payload sent to local Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B endpoint
Structured RCA JSON returned containing root_cause and proposed_patch
Graceful fallback to deterministic heuristic when endpoint is unreachable
test_cases.notes: Verified against live local LLM inference endpoint

test_cases.scenario: Healer bot symphonix-healer[bot] authors remediation patch; merge to main is strictly blocked until dual human review (incl. certified CSO) is recorded
expected_outcomes: Patch commit annotated with DID did:symphonix:agent:healer-v1
Attempt to merge without dual human review fails closed with ErrDCB0129ProvenanceViolation
Merge unblocked after recorded CSO approval
test_cases.preconditions: Self-healing remediation PR created on repository
test_cases.notes: Strict machine-authored code barrier on live service

test_cases.scenario: Attempt to quarantine a clinical safety test (clinical/sepsis_triage_test.go) via API; service rejects request with HTTP 422 ErrClinicalTestCannotBeQuarantined
expected_outcomes: Service inspects test path against clinical immune boundary
Quarantine request refused with HTTP 422
Clinical safety test remains mandatory for pipeline pass
test_cases.preconditions: Quarantine management endpoint active on live server
test_cases.notes: Enforces clinical safety invariance across live API

test_cases.scenario: Turn 1 dev proposes patch deleting assert.Equal or lowering vital sign threshold; Turn 2 Clinical Safety Auditor rejects patch with HazardCritical
expected_outcomes: Multi-agent validator analyzes unified diff line by line
Relaxation of clinical assertion triggers HazardCritical
Patch rejected and safety audit record generated
test_cases.preconditions: Multi-agent dual-turn check enabled on live server

test_data.proposed_diff:
--- a/eval.go
+++ b/eval.go
- assert.Equal(t, vital.OxygenSaturation >= 92)
+ // relaxed check

test_cases.notes: Scrutiny of AI patches to prevent clinical threshold drift

test_cases.scenario: Service queries PostgreSQL historical telemetry; computes P95 + 20% headroom; pre-allocates 3.6GB to container before start; prevents initial Exit 137 OOM
expected_outcomes: Historical P95 query returns 3000MB peak memory
Rightsizer computes 3600MB allocation (+20% headroom)
Pipeline launches with rightsized memory and zero OOM exits
test_cases.preconditions: Historical step execution data present in PostgreSQL 16
test_cases.notes: Eliminates the initial Exit 137 crash before container start

test_cases.scenario: Generate bounded counterfactual FHIR R4 Observations (+-1% / +-2%) across clinical decision boundary; verifies absence of catastrophic sensitivity cliff
expected_outcomes: FHIR R4 Observation resource generated with minimal perturbation
Clinical classification remains stable within +-2% tolerance
Validation passes schema and profile adherence checks
test_cases.preconditions: FHIR validation service active on live server
test_cases.notes: Proves model robustness across decision boundaries
